business_summary: Central Development Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, manufacture, and wholesale of jewelry products in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company operates through Jewelry Business and Energy Business segments. It manufactures and sells solar module intelligent technology products; and sells refined oil and liquefied natural gas. The company was formerly known as Zhong Fa Zhan Holdings Limited and changed its name to Central Development Holdings Limited in October 2019. Central Development Holdings Limited was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Central Development Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Resources Rich Capital Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Central Development Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 보석 제품의 디자인, 제조 및 도매에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 보석 사업과 에너지 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 태양광 모듈 지능형 기술 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 정제유와 액화천연가스를 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Zhong Fa Zhan Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2019년 10월에 Central Development Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Central Development Holdings Limited는 1983년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Central Development Holdings Limited는 Resources Rich Capital Limited의 자회사입니다.
